Kawara Shrine can refer to two shrines in [[Ise Grand Shrine]]
*{{ill|Kawara Shrine (Naikū)|ja|狭田国生神社}} (川原神社)
*{{ill|Kawara Shrine (Gekū)|ja|河原神社 (伊勢市)}} (河原神社)
**its sessha {{ill|Kawarabuchi Shrine|ja|河原淵神社}}
There is also the similarly names

{{ill|Kawarabuchi Shrine|ja|河原淵神社}} located near {{ill|Kawara Shrine (Gekū)|ja|河原神社 (伊勢市)}}
